Your digital product checkout is more than a payment button. 👀 If you sell ebooks, templates, courses, guides, Canva templates, or other digital products, you need to think about what happens after someone clicks “buy.” Before selling your first digital product, make sure you have: 1️⃣ Purchase terms — what the customer is actually agreeing to when they buy. 2️⃣ License & use restrictions — what they can and cannot do with your product. 3️⃣ Privacy Policy — especially if you’re collecting customer information. 4️⃣ Website/store terms — the rules governing purchases and use of your store. 5️⃣ Protection against unauthorized sharing & reselling — because your digital product should not become the internet’s free download. 😭 Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. And remember: your legal protection shouldn’t start after someone steals or misuses your digital product. It should be part of your business from the beginning. videos.caption: Instead of binge watching Netflix tonight, build something.  Here’s exactly what to do. Step by step.  Step 1️⃣ open Claude. It’s free. Type this prompt: “help me outline a 10-15 page ebook about (your topic) for (your audience). Give me a chapter structure with a one sentence description for each section.  Step 2️⃣ Write it. Use this prompt for each section: “write a short conversational section on (subtopic). Simple language. One real example. Under 250 words. Draft each section. Rewrite in your voice. One at a time.  Step 3️⃣ Name it. Use this prompt: “Give me 10 names for an ebook about (topic) for (audience). Mix descriptive with punchy. Avoid cliches. Pick one. Move on. Don’t overthink this part.  Step 4️⃣ Open Canva. Search “ebook template”. Pick one. Paste your content. Change the colors. Export as a PDF.  Step 5️⃣ Upload to Beacons or Stan Store. Set the price at $25. Write your sales description using this prompt: “Write a 4 sentence sales description for a product called (name) for (audience) that teaches (outcome). Calm and  trustworthy, not hype-y. Paste it. You’re live. That’s it. One evening. One product. Selling on repeat.  $25 x 100 buyers = $2,500/month. The tools are free (unless you use Stan store). The prompt s are above.
